Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 13
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly consolidated Cantora 1 and Cantora 2 into a single “double album” despite the Wikipedia Studio albums list showing them as two separate 2009 studio releases. This led to undercounting (2 instead of the correct 3: 2005 Corazón Libre, 2009 Cantora 1, 2009 Cantora 2).
